# Progressive Newsroom

> > Progressive Insurance's official newsroom providing press releases, news coverage, media resources, and company announcements for journalists and media partners.

Progressive Newsroom is the central hub for media relations and press communications from Progressive Insurance. The site features current news releases, third-party coverage, company facts, and multimedia assets designed to support journalists covering the insurance industry and Progressive's initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Progressive Insurance
- Press releases
- News coverage
- Insurance products
- Pet insurance
- Homeownership initiative
- Open the House
- Media alerts
- Down-payment assistance
- First-generation homebuyers
- Company announcements
- Media assets
- Press resources
- Media relations
- Keys to Progress

## Newsroom Hub

- [Recent News Releases & Coverage](https://progressive.mediaroom.com): Progressive Insurance newsroom homepage with latest news releases and coverage
- [Newsroom Overview](https://progressive.mediaroom.com/overview): Progressive newsroom overview with news releases, coverage and company updates

## Press Releases & Announcements

- [News Releases Archive](https://progressive.mediaroom.com/news-releases): Archive of Progressive Insurance press releases and announcements

- [Pet Insurance Product Launch](https://progressive.mediaroom.com/2026-01-20-progressive-insurance-R-introduces-pet-insurance-for-cats-and-dogs): Progressive announces pet insurance product launch for cats and dogs
